## Techniques and Protocols

### Expansion microscopy

Detailed protocols with recommended reagents on the
[Guichard/Hamel Lab site](https://mocel.unige.ch/research-groups/guichard-hamel/expansion-microscopy/protocols)

**Reference publications:** [U-ExM](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-018-0238-1) (ultrastructure, 4x),
[Cryo-ExM](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-021-01356-4) (cryo-fixed samples),
[iU-ExM](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-023-43582-8) (iterative, 16x)

**Usage examples:** [Plankton](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2025.09.027) (link to [dataset](https://github.com/Dey-Lab-Team/culture-collections_)),
delicate [T-cell fixation using Cryo-ExM](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.celrep.2026.117165),
[Euglena cytoskeleton](https://doi.org/10.26508/lsa.202403110) ([protocol](https://doi.org/10.1007/978-1-0716-5146-9_13)),

**Training and workshops**: EMBL course and other resources on [Guichard/Hamel Lab site](https://mocel.unige.ch/research-groups/guichard-hamel/expansion-microscopy/exm-workshops)

### Single-cell TEM

[Single-cell TEM protocol](https://doi.org/10.1111/jeu.70061) for cells in environmental samples

### Protist single-cell transcriptomics

[My version of the protocol](/files/SingleCellTranscriptomeProtocol-v201804_GL.pdf) based on Smartseq2
([Picelli et al. 2014](https://doi.org/10.1038/nprot.2014.006); [protocol PDF](/files/Nature_Protocols_Picelli-ea_2014_Smartseq2.pdf)) that was reworked for protists by Gordon Lax and Martin Kolisko
 (quality check by cloning+Sanger no longer worthwhile in 2020s)
